approval_message: Root independently reviewed finite-volume-proposal.md. Approve exact intermediate statements A and B for implementation, with volume(V)<top, uniform finite K and B, measurable t_j⊆V, bounded overlap, and finite-subset fiber cardinality as written. The upper measure estimate follows countable subadditivity/Lipschitz distortion and Tonelli on indicators; B uses injection of active finite chart indices into the fiber. No measurability of image is needed for the bound. These remain supporting lemmas, never hypotheses of frozen TR-06 final statements. Implement A/B and retain proposal hash + this pre-proof review in evidence. Then propose C with an exact Lean boundary before implementation. Root agrees D remains unproved and must be discharged, not assumed.
